title: The Whispered Prayer of the Hopeful

readings.title: 04. The Whispered Prayer of the Hopeful (Rajeen)
readings.description: The fourth of the fifteen whispered prayers attributed to Imam al-Sajjad (عليه السلام).
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation transcribed from Duas.org's Sahifa Sajjadiya page; attribution requested by the source.

records.arabic_text: يا مَنْ إذا سَأَلَهُ عَبْدٌ أَعْطاهُ،
records.transliteration: yaa man id'a saalahoo a'b-dun aa'-t'aahoo
records.english_text: O He who gives to a servant who asks from Him,

records.arabic_text: وَإذا أَمَّلَ ما عِنْدَهُ بَلَّغَهُ مُناهُ،
records.transliteration: wa id'aaa am-mala maa i'ndahoo bal-laghahoo munaahoo
records.english_text: takes him to his wish when he expectantly hopes for what is with Him,

records.transliteration: wa id'aaa aq-bala a'lay-hee qar-rabahoo wa ad-naah
records.english_text: brings him near and close when he approaches Him,

records.arabic_text: وَإِذا جاهَرَهُ بِالْعِصْيانِ سَتَرَ عَلَىٰ ذَنْبِهِ وَغَطَّاهُ،
records.transliteration: wa id'a jaaharahoo bil-i's'-yaani satara a'laa d'ambihee wa ghat'-t'aahoo
records.english_text: covers over his sin and cloaks it when he shows it openly,

records.transliteration: wa id'a tawak-kala a'lay-heee ah'-sabahoo wa kafaah
records.english_text: and satisfies and suffices him when he has confidence in Him!

records.arabic_text: إِلـٰهِي مَنِ الَّذِي نَزَلَ بِكَ مُلْتَمِساً قِراكَ فَما قَرَيْتَهُ؟
records.transliteration: ilaahee manil-lad'ee nazala bika mul-tamisan qiraaka famaa qaray-tah
records.english_text: My God, who is the one who has come before You seeking hospitality, and whom You have not received hospitably?

records.arabic_text: وَمَنِ الَّذِي أَناخَ بِبابِكَ مُرْتَجِياً نَداكَ فَما أَوْلَيْتَهُ؟
records.transliteration: wa manil-lad'eee anakha bibaabika mur-tajeean-nadaaka famaaa aw-lay-tah
records.english_text: Who is the one who has dismounted at Your door hoping for magnanimity, and to whom You have not shown it?

records.arabic_text: أَيَحْسُنُ أَنْ أَرْجِعَ عَنْ بابِكَ بِالْخَيْبَةِ مَصْرُوفاً،
records.transliteration: ayah'-sunu an ar-jia' a'm-baabika bil-khay-bati mas'-roofan
records.english_text: Is it good that I come back from Your door, turned away in disappointment,

records.arabic_text: وَلَسْتُ أَعْرِفُ سِواكَ مَوْلىً بِالإِحْسانِ مَوْصُوفاً؟
records.transliteration: wa las-tu aa'-rifu siwaaka maw-lan bil-ih'-saani maw-s'oofan
records.english_text: while I know of no patron qualified by beneficence but You?

records.arabic_text: كَيْفَ أَرْجُو غَيْرَكَ وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ بِيَدِكَ؟
records.transliteration: kayfa ar-joo ghay-raka wal-khay-ru kul-luhoo beeadik
records.english_text: How should I have hope in other than You, when the good - all of it - is in Your hand?

records.arabic_text: وَكَيْفَ أُؤَمِّلُ سِواكَ وَالْخَلْقُ وَالأَمْرُ لَكَ؟
records.transliteration: wa kay-fa oo-am-milu siwaaka wal-khal-qu wal-am-ru lak
records.english_text: How should I expect from others, when for You are the creation and the command?

records.arabic_text: أَأَقْطَعُ رَجائِي مِنْكَ وَقَدْ أَوْلَيْتَنِي ما لَمْ أَسْأَلْهُ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ؟
records.transliteration: aaq-t'au' rajaaa-ee minka wa qad aw-lay-tanee maa lam as-al-hoo min faz''-lika
records.english_text: Should I cut off my hope for You, when You have shown me of Your bounty that for which I have not asked?

records.arabic_text: أَمْ تُفْقِرُنِي إلىٰ مِثْلِي وَأَنا أَعْتَصِمُ بِحَبْلِكَ؟
records.transliteration: am tuf-qiruny ilaa mith-lee wa ana aa'-tas'imu bih'ab-lika
records.english_text: Would You make me have need for my like whilst I hold fast to Your cord?!

records.transliteration: yaa man sai'da birah'-matihil-qaas'idoona
records.english_text: O He through whose mercy the strivers reach felicity

records.transliteration: wa lam yash-qa binaqimatihil-mus-tagh-firoon
records.english_text: and through whose vengeance the seekers of forgiveness are not made wretched!

records.transliteration: kay-fa ansaaka walam tazal d'aakiree
records.english_text: How should I forget You, while You never cease remembering me?

records.transliteration: wa kay-fa al-hoo a'nka wa anta muraaqibee
records.english_text: How should I be diverted from You while You are my constant watcher?

records.transliteration: ilaahee bid'ay-li karamika aa'-laq-tu yadee
records.english_text: My God, I have fastened my hand to the skirt of Your generosity,

records.transliteration: wa linay-li a't'aayaaka basat'-tu amalee
records.english_text: I have stretched forth my expectation toward reaching Your gifts,

records.transliteration: faakh-lis'-nee bikhaalis'ati taw-h'eedika
records.english_text: so render me pure through the purest profession of Your Unity,

records.transliteration: waj-a'l-nee min s'af-wati a'beedik
records.english_text: and appoint me one of Your choice servants!

records.arabic_text: يا مَنْ كُلُّ هارِبٍ إلَيْهِ يَلْتَجِئُ،
records.transliteration: yaa man-kul-lu haaribin ilay-hee yal-taji-u
records.english_text: O He who is the asylum of every fleer,

records.transliteration: wa kul-lu t'aalibin ee-yaahoo yar-tjee
records.english_text: the hope of every seeker!

records.transliteration: yaa khay-ra mar-joo
records.english_text: O Best Object of hope!

records.transliteration: wa yaaa ak-rama mad-u'w
records.english_text: O Most Generous Object of supplication!

records.transliteration: wa yaa mal-laa yurad-du saaa-iluh
records.english_text: O He who does not reject His asker

records.transliteration: wa laa yukhay-yabu aaamiluh
records.english_text: or disappoint the expectant!

records.transliteration: yaa mam-baabuhoo maf-tooh'ul-lidaae'eh
records.english_text: O He whose door is open to His supplicators

records.transliteration: wa h'ijaabuhoo mar-foou'l-liraajeehee
records.english_text: and whose veil is lifted for those who hope in Him!

records.arabic_text: أَسْأَلُكَ بِكَرَمِكَ أَنْ تَمُنَّ عَلَيَّ مِنْ عَطائِكَ بِما تَقَرُّ بِهِ عَيْنِي،
records.transliteration: as-aluka bikaramika an tamun-na a'lay-ya min a't'aaa-ika bima taqar-ru bihee a'y-nee
records.english_text: I ask You by Your generosity to show kindness toward me through Your gifts, with that which will gladden my eye,

records.arabic_text: وَمِنْ رَجائِكَ بِما تَطْمَئِنُّ بِهِ نَفْسِي،
records.transliteration: wa mir-rajaaa-ika bima tat'-ma-in-nu bihee naf-see
records.english_text: through hope in You, with that which will give serenity to my soul,

records.arabic_text: وَمِنَ الْيَقِينِ بِما تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيَّ مُصِيباتِ الدُّنْيا،
records.transliteration: wa minal-yaqeeni bima tuhaw-winu bihee a'lay-ya mus'eebaatid-dunyaa
records.english_text: and through certainty with that which will make easy for me the afflictions of this world

records.arabic_text: وَتَجْلُو بِهِ عَنْ بَصِيرَتِي غَشَواتِ الْعَمىٰ،
records.transliteration: wa taj-loo bihee a'n bas'eeratee ghashawaatil-a'maa
records.english_text: and lift from my insight the veils of blindness!

records.transliteration: birah'-matika yaaa ar-h'amar-raah'imeen
records.english_text: By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
